description: This file contains validation rules and utility functions for form validation in an HR management system, including functions for required fields, date and time validation, file validation, and specific format checks.

methods.name: required
methods.description: Checks if the input value is present and non-empty, supporting string, number, array, and object types.

methods.name: shouldNotExceedCharLength
methods.description: Validates that a string does not exceed a specified character length.

methods.name: validDateFormat
methods.description: Checks if a date string matches the specified format.

methods.name: shouldBeCurrentOrPreviousDate
methods.description: Validates that a date is today or a previous date.

methods.name: validTimeFormat
methods.description: Checks if a time string matches the HH:mm format.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Ensures a numeric value is less than a specified maximum.

methods.name: digitsOnly
methods.description: Validates that a string contains digits only.

methods.name: numericOnly
methods.description: Validates that a string is a numeric value.

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithDecimalPoint
methods.description: Validates that a string is a number with optional decimal point.

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithDecimalPointAndMinusSign
methods.description: Validates that a string is a number with optional decimal point and minus sign.

methods.name: beforeDate
methods.description: Checks if date1 is before date2 based on a specified format.

methods.name: afterDate
methods.description: Checks if date1 is after date2.

methods.name: sameDate
methods.description: Checks if date1 is the same as date2.

methods.name: endDateShouldBeAfterStartDate
methods.description: Validates that an end date is after a start date.

methods.name: beforeTime
methods.description: Checks if time1 is before time2.

methods.name: afterTime
methods.description: Checks if time1 is after time2.

methods.name: sameTime
methods.description: Checks if time1 equals time2.

methods.name: endTimeShouldBeAfterStartTime
methods.description: Validates that an end time is after a start time.

methods.name: maxFileSize
methods.description: Checks if a file's size is within a maximum limit.

methods.name: validFileTypes
methods.description: Validates that a file's type is within an allowed list.

methods.name: validEmailFormat
methods.description: Validates that a string matches email format.

methods.name: validPhoneNumberFormat
methods.description: Validates that a string contains only phone number characters.

methods.name: startDateShouldBeBeforeEndDate
methods.description: Ensures a start date is before an end date.

methods.name: maxCurrency
methods.description: Checks if a currency value is below a maximum.

methods.name: startTimeShouldBeBeforeEndTime
methods.description: Ensures a start time is before an end time.

methods.name: shouldNotLessThanCharLength
methods.description: Checks if a string is at least a certain length.

methods.name: maxValueShouldBeGreaterThanMinValue
methods.description: Validates that a value exceeds a minimum value.

methods.name: minValueShouldBeLowerThanMaxValue
methods.description: Validates that a value is below a maximum.

methods.name: numberShouldBeBetweenMinAndMaxValue
methods.description: Checks if a number falls between min and max.

methods.name: validHexFormat
methods.description: Validates that a string is a valid hex color.

methods.name: imageShouldHaveDimensions
methods.description: Checks image dimensions against an aspect ratio.

methods.name: greaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Validates that a number is greater than or equal to a value.

methods.name: lessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Validates that a number is less than or equal to a value.

methods.name: validLangString
methods.description: Validates the syntax of language-specific strings.

methods.name: validSelection
methods.description: Validates selection fields for correctness.

methods.name: validHostnameFormat
methods.description: Validates hostname or IP address format.

methods.name: validPortRange
methods.description: Validates port range numbers.

methods.name: validVideoURL
methods.description: Validates YouTube video URL.

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithTwoDecimalPoints
methods.description: Validates numbers with up to two decimal points.

ctags.name: digitsOnly
ctags.pattern: /^export const digitsOnly = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: lessThanOrEqual
ctags.pattern: /^export const lessThanOrEqual = function (maxValue: number, message?: string) {$/

ctags.name: numericOnly
ctags.pattern: /^export const numericOnly = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validEmailFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validEmailFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validHostnameFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validHostnameFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validSelection
ctags.pattern: /^export const validSelection = function (value: string | object | null) {$/

ctags.name: validTimeFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validTimeFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validVideoURL
ctags.pattern: /^export const validVideoURL = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/
